summary: Export the ecosystem Twin agent binding

delivery.outcome: Publish a closed, machine-readable ecosystem Twin binding for sequential Doctor, Repair and Validator handoffs without granting runtime authority.
nonGoals: No Subactor runtime implementation or controller changes
No repair execution or merge authority
No new lifecycle blueprint or schema family

architecture.decision: Add a closed data-only binding over service-observe-repair/v1 and validate adjacent stages, fixed roles, digest bindings, external mutation authority and independent validation.
architecture.rollback: Remove the optional binding profile and its conformance checks; lifecycle blueprints remain unchanged

validation.evidence: Positive profile and three adversarial binding cases are reported
Exactly one integration ticket owns the binding standard and docs
